name: Obedience · 'retry' re-delivers the same thing, not new content
description: Promoted from a real harvested failure (2026-08-18 backfill, obedience=0): the operator reported an app glitch and said 'Retry', and Nick barreled into brand-new content instead of re-sending the deliverable that was lost. A retry request is a re-delivery instruction, not an invitation to continue the conversation. Content rewritten pattern-preserving; no operator PII.

messages.content: Give me the checklist for closing the shop on Saturdays.

Saturday close checklist: 1) Bay doors down and locked by 4:45. 2) Compressor off, air lines bled. 3) Register count + drop in the safe. 4) Waste oil caps sealed. 5) Alarm armed, side door deadbolted. 6) Lot walk for tools and jacks left out.
The whole app was bugging and I lost that. Retry

judgeCriteria.description: Re-sends the same Saturday close checklist (same 6 items, same substance). A retry after a reported glitch means re-deliver the lost output.
Does NOT pivot to new content, new questions, or a different deliverable. Automatic fail if the checklist is replaced by something else.
No commentary about the glitch, no 'as I said before' framing — just the re-delivery, clean.

expectedBehavior: The same checklist again, verbatim or near-verbatim, with at most a one-word acknowledgment. Nothing new.
